title: The Scorched #57
desc: FEATURES THE APPEARANCE OF A MAJOR VILLAIN IN THE SPAWN FRANCHISE! She-Spawn embarks on a quest to find the source of her disturbing visions of the future, but not before she is forced to forge an alliance with one of the darkest and most brutal HELLSPAWNS she has ever encountered. Will their UNKINDNESS help resolve the mystery, or is there a deeper CONSPIRACY to uncover? Part one of an epic story that will bridge the gap between the Spawn Universe's lost past and its shadowy future.
